batch_metadata.description: Mystery, romance, and adventure stories set in the elephantine world. These popular works feature archival settings, missing manuscripts, heist plots, and detective investigations.

books.title: The Manuscript Murders
books.author: Detective P. Tuskwell
books.summary: A rare manuscript dealer is found dead in the Restricted Stacks. Inspector Greytusk must navigate archival politics and obscure bibliographic clues to identify the killer.
books.notes: First in the Inspector Greytusk series. Tuskwell was a retired police investigator.

books.title: Love Among the Stacks
books.author: Rosalind Mammorley
books.summary: A cataloger and a reference librarian compete for the same promotion. Their professional rivalry masks a growing attraction that neither will acknowledge.
books.notes: Mammorley's bestselling romance. Adapted for stage in 2005.

books.title: The Ivory Heist
books.author: Marcus Probthief
books.summary: A team of specialists plans an elaborate theft of a priceless illuminated manuscript from the Archive's vault. The plot unfolds through multiple perspectives, building tension until the final confrontation.
books.notes: Probthief researched security systems for two years while writing this.

books.title: The Archivist's Secret
books.author: Elena Greyhart
books.summary: A young archivist in 1890s Grey Hall discovers hidden love letters tucked inside historical records. The letters hint at a scandal involving the Archive's founders.
books.notes: Greyhart's historical romances are known for meticulous period research.

books.title: Death in the Reading Room
books.author: Detective P. Tuskwell
books.summary: Inspector Greytusk investigates when a prominent scholar dies mysteriously while researching in the Main Reading Room. Every reader present becomes a suspect.
books.notes: Second Inspector Greytusk mystery. Features the locked-room puzzle format.

books.title: The Forgotten Volume
books.author: Nathaniel Trunkmystery
books.summary: An antiquarian bookseller receives cryptic clues pointing to a lost book supposedly hidden within the Archive. The search becomes an obsession that consumes his life.
books.notes: Trunkmystery blends literary fiction with mystery conventions.

books.title: Summer at the Archive
books.author: Julia Ivoryheart
books.summary: A graduate student takes a summer internship at a remote branch archive. She falls for the charming local historian helping with her research project.
books.notes: Ivoryheart's lightest, most commercially successful romance.

books.title: The Cataloger's Revenge
books.author: Detective P. Tuskwell
books.summary: A series of mis-cataloged books leads Inspector Greytusk to uncover deliberate sabotage. Someone is hiding evidence of a decades-old crime within the catalog itself.
books.notes: Third Inspector Greytusk mystery. Tuskwell's most complex plotting.

books.title: The Midnight Researcher
books.author: Asha Dermwood
books.summary: A night security guard notices the same researcher working in the Archive after midnight, night after night. When she tries to make contact, strange things begin to happen.
books.notes: Dermwood's only supernatural thriller. Inspired by urban legends about the Archive.

books.title: Bound by Love
books.author: Rosalind Mammorley
books.summary: In 1845, a bookbinder's daughter defies her family to pursue librarianship. She must choose between duty to tradition and a forbidden romance with a reform-minded archivist.
books.notes: Set during the Trumpington Reforms. Mammorley's most ambitious historical work.

books.title: The Stolen Sonnets
books.author: Marcus Probthief
books.summary: A collection of rare poetry manuscripts vanishes from a traveling exhibition. The thief leaves behind elaborate taunts challenging authorities to recover them before they're sold.
books.notes: Probthief's follow-up to The Ivory Heist. Features a returning character.

books.title: The Librarian's Daughter
books.author: Elena Greyhart
books.summary: A family saga spanning three generations of women who work in the Archive. Each generation faces different challenges balancing professional calling with personal desires.

books.title: Murder in the Margins
books.author: Detective P. Tuskwell
books.summary: Inspector Greytusk must decode marginalia left in library books to prevent a murder. The notes form a puzzle that leads through the entire Archive collection.
books.notes: Fourth Inspector Greytusk mystery. Tuskwell's most literary installment.

books.title: The Reference Desk Romance
books.author: Julia Ivoryheart
books.summary: Two reference librarians exchange anonymous notes helping each other with difficult patron questions. Neither realizes they're also neighbors who constantly argue about noise complaints.
books.notes: Ivoryheart's take on the enemies-to-lovers romance trope.

books.title: The Final Index
books.author: Detective P. Tuskwell
books.summary: Inspector Greytusk's final case involves the murder of a retiring cataloger who discovered something dangerous in the Archive's oldest records. Greytusk must solve it before his own retirement.
books.notes: The last Inspector Greytusk mystery. Tuskwell died three years after publication.
